title: Transformer: V_s / V_p vs leakage
description: Run the two-winding transformer at full drive, once tightly coupled (k = 0.97) and once with the leakage toggle (k = 0.72), and compare rms(V_s)/rms(V_p). Tightly coupled, the ratio sits just under the turns ratio N_s/N_p = 40/120; leakage inductance drops a large share of V_s before the load. Sampled at 2400 Hz (40 points per 60 Hz cycle) on a 1/2400 s step, so the AC waveform is resolved rather than aliased. Simulated, not metrology.

summaryExpect.label: ideal coupling: V_s/V_p within 10 % of N_s/N_p = 1/3
